claim.claim-text: 1. A stethoscope device comprising: a stethoscope head (110) comprising a mechanical diaphragm (200) for receiving a stethoscopic audio signal from an object;

2. The stethoscope device of claim 1, further comprising: a control (620) for operating the device in one or more of a stethoscopic mode, an ultrasonic imaging mode, or a non-stethoscopic, non-ultrasonic mode.

3. The stethoscope device of claim 2, wherein the control comprises a user interface (640) configured to provide a user with feedback based on the stethoscopic signal, the ultrasonic signal, or the non-stethoscopic, non-ultrasonic signal.
4. The stethoscope device of claim 1, further comprising a housing coupled to one or more of the stethoscope head, the first ultrasonic transducer, the audio transducer, and the interference circuit.

5. The stethoscope device of claim 1, further comprising a second ultrasonic transducer (210B) for transmitting a second transmitted ultrasonic imaging signal to the object at a second frequency different from the first frequency and receiving a second received ultrasonic imaging signal from the object at the second frequency.
6. The stethoscope device of claim 5, wherein the first and second ultrasonic transducers are configured to transmit and receive simultaneously with one another.

7. The stethoscope device of claim 5, wherein the stethoscope device is configured reconstruct, using the first received ultrasonic imaging signal and the second received ultrasonic imaging signal, an ultrasonic image.

8. The stethoscope device of claim 5, wherein the frequency of the first transmitted ultrasonic imaging signal is selected from the group consisting of: 100 kHz, 200 kHz, 300 kHz, 400 kHz, 500 kHz, 650 kHz, 700 kHz, 800 kHz, 850 kHz, 900 kHz, 1 MHz, 2 MHz, 3 MHz, 5. 5 MHz, 6 MHz, 8 MHz, and 11 MHz; and the frequency of the second transmitted ultrasonic imaging signal is in the frequency range of 0.5 MHz - 30 MHz.
9. The stethoscope device of claim 5, wherein the first ultrasonic transducer (210A) has a bandwidth that partially overlaps with the bandwidth of at least the second ultrasonic transducer.

10. The stethoscope device of claim 1, further comprising: a nonstethoscopic, non-ultrasonic sensor (520) for detecting a non-stethoscopic, nonultrasonic signal, the non-stethoscopic, non-ultrasonic sensor (520) selected from the group consisting of: a non-stethoscopic audio sensor, a temperature sensor, an optical sensor, an electrical sensor, and an electrochemical sensor.
11. The stethoscope device of claim 10, wherein the non-stethoscopic, non-ultrasonic sensor (520) comprises an optical sensor.

13. The stethoscope device of claim 10, wherein the non-stethoscopic, nonultrasonic sensor (520) is configured to detect a signal originating from the group consisting of: a body temperature, a respiration rate, a respiration quality, a respiration pathology, a blood pressure level, a blood glucose concentration level, a blood gas concentration level, and a blood oxygenation saturation (spO<2>) level.

14. The stethoscope device of claim 10, further comprising a wireless networking modality configured to communicate the stethoscopic audio signal, first received ultrasonic signal, or non-stethoscopic, non-ultrasonic signal to a peripheral device.
